description:
Powerful Ebike
The e-bike has a 250W high-power motor and can reach a maximum speed of 25km/h. The 26-inch electric bicycles for men and women offer you a smooth riding experience to be free and explore nature in the mountains and in the city.
Protection for Safe Driving
Front and rear double disc brakes and electronic brakes fully improve braking performance and shorten braking distances. Also, custom front and rear disc brakes provide additional protection while riding. Safety LED headlights and bike bells make you safer when you go out. Especially at night because you can be seen and heard by cars and pedestrians.
Detachable Lithium Battery
Detachable 12AH/36V lithium battery, no longer worry about the problem of having nowhere to charge. At the same time, the longest battery life of electric bicycles can reach 35-70 kilometers. (Specific data will be affected by rider weight, temperature, road conditions, etc.)
High-Speed and Safe
250W high-performance brushless motor with low magnetic resistance. Equipped with automotive-grade power lithium battery, the output is strong and the output is efficient and stable. The battery can be recharged after removal, which is more convenient and safer. Electric bicycles have CE certification, pursuing environmental protection and fashionable quality of life.
Complies with EU/UK road regulations

The BK8 Electric Bike is a reliable choice for those seeking a safe and legal rides, as it complies with all EU and UK road regulations and carries the necessary product certificates. Currently the BK8 is the one with the throttle removed. If you need to use the throttle, you can purchase the throttle accessory in HITWAY website.
